decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extensions  hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Reason for Approval: It is considered that the development complies with the Council's U.D.P. policies ENV- B.1.1 (All New Development); ENV-B.2.2. (Conservation Areas); ENV-B.1.4 (Setting of Listed Buildings). It would not cause loss of amenity to neighbouring residential properties, would preserve and enhance the character of Bedford Park Conservation Area and not adversely affect the setting of the adjoining listed building.
description: Erection of single storey rear conservatory, erection of first floor extension and rear double doors incorporating internal alterations to dwellinghouse
